Title: Overly Permissive RLS on voyage_briefs Exposes Customer PII to Public Read and Tampering
Evidence: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Public can view voyage briefs"; CREATE POLICY ... ON public.voyage_briefs FOR SELECT TO anon, authenticated USING (true);
Business Impact: Direct unauthorized read access to customer names phone numbers charter budgets and private celebration notes; unauthorized status modification
Recommended Fix: Revoke public SELECT and UPDATE policies on voyage_briefs and restrict access exclusively to public.is_admin()

Title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Admin Portal via Unescaped Voyage Briefs Table Rendering
Business Impact: Attackers submitting voyage briefs can execute JavaScript in the authenticated browser of administrators leading to session hijacking and administrative takeover
Recommended Fix: Wrap all user-supplied brief fields with escapeHtml() before innerHTML interpolation

Title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via Public Gallery Insertion and Unescaped Homepage Rendering
Evidence: Policy allows anon INSERT on gallery_images; main.js renders item.innerHTML with unescaped img.title and img.subtitle
Business Impact: Anonymous users can inject malicious HTML/script payloads that execute on all visitors of the landing page and administrators viewing media manager
Recommended Fix: Restrict gallery_images INSERT to public.is_admin() and apply strict HTML escaping in renderDynamicGalleryImages and renderMediaGrid

Title: Lack of Server-Side Authorization Verification (is_admin) in Admin Frontend UI Shell
Evidence: signUpAdmin allows arbitrary registration; UI grants entry to dashboard on valid session without checking public.is_admin()
Business Impact: Non-admin accounts can enter the admin portal interface view unhedged tables (such as voyage_briefs) and attempt unauthorized actions
Recommended Fix: Check RPC public.is_admin() before rendering portal screen and log out unauthorized accounts immediately

Title: Unrestricted Resource Consumption and DoS via Unthrottled Order Creation (/api/create-order)
Evidence: Endpoint accepts POST without rate limiting, CAPTCHA, or IP throttling, creating a 15-minute slot lock and calling Razorpay Orders API
Business Impact: Malicious automated requests can lock the entire calendar across all dates for 15 minutes
column11: Implement IP/session rate limiting (e.g. Upstash Redis / Vercel KV) and require Cloudflare Turnstile or reCAPTCHA on checkout initiation

Title: Spreadsheet Formula Injection (CSV Injection) in Admin Community Member Export
Evidence: csvCell(v) only escapes double quotes but does not sanitize leading formula characters (=, +, -, @, \t, \r)
Business Impact: Opening exported CSV files in Excel or Google Sheets executes malicious formulas that can exfiltrate local data or execute commands
Recommended Fix: Prepend an apostrophe (') or tab space to any cell value starting with =

Title: Complete Absence of HTTP Security Headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options Clickjacking Protection)
Evidence: No headers object defined in vercel.json; missing CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy
Business Impact: Allows clickjacking of booking engine and admin portal; allows execution of untrusted scripts; lacks enforcement of strict HTTPS transport
Recommended Fix: Add security headers block in vercel.json including strict Content-Security-Policy

Title: Excessive Data Exposure in Boarding Pass Verification API (/api/booking)
Evidence: toPublicBooking returns phone, email, notes, and paymentId on public QR verification scan
Business Impact: Pier and dock boarding staff scanning boarding passes are exposed to customer private contact details and private notes
column11: and private notes from toPublicBooking; only return passenger name

Title: Unrestricted HTTP Request Body Buffering in Serverless Functions
Evidence: readRawBody buffers incoming stream chunks with no byte ceiling
Business Impact: Potential memory exhaustion on serverless runtime if subjected to massive payload streaming
Recommended Fix: Enforce a strict payload size limit (e.g. 64 KB or 128 KB) in readRawBody and reject oversized requests with HTTP 413

Title: Public Read Access to Traffic Analytics (public.page_views)
Evidence: Policy 'Public can view page views' grants anon SELECT on public.page_views
Business Impact: External parties can monitor visitor volume
Status: and device analytics by directly querying Supabase
column11: Restrict public.page_views SELECT policy to public.is_admin()

Title: Deprecated Mock Payment Code in main.js Bypassing Server API
Evidence: Dead prototype code simulates ₹5,000 hold deposit without invoking /api/create-order or Razorpay verification
Business Impact: Code maintenance confusion; harmless in production as long as openBookingModal redirects to /book
Recommended Fix: Clean up dead booking modal functions from main.js to ensure only /book is the single booking path
